purpose: How governments designate, build, move, contest, and use capitals; distinguish legal status from the location of institutions and from the largest city.
editorial_principles: Use a named jurisdiction and date for every capital status claim.
Separate legal designation, effective institutional location, and population size.
Attribute contested claims and give affected communities a sourced voice.
Select a bounded case and verify primary sources before production.
